name: sk-baghel-tour-travels
description: SK Baghel Tour & Travels — monorepo for the customer site (react/), operations desk (admin/) and API (backend/).

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix react ci && npm --prefix admin ci && npm --prefix backend ci
scripts.verify: npm run customer:typecheck && npm run admin:typecheck && npm run backend:typecheck && npm run customer:validate-config && npm test && npm run customer:seo && npm run build:all
scripts.typecheck: npm run customer:typecheck && npm run admin:typecheck && npm run backend:typecheck
scripts.build:all: npm run customer:build && npm run admin:build && npm run backend:build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test:ci && npm --prefix react run test:catalog-sources && npm --prefix admin test
scripts.deploy:customer: npm --prefix react ci && VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://skb-baghel-api-staging.onrender.com VITE_SITE_URL=https://agraskbagheltourandtravels.com VITE_SITE_MODE=production RELEASE_BUILD=1 npm run customer:build && npx wrangler pages deploy react/dist --project-name skbagheltravels-customer
scripts.deploy:admin: npm --prefix admin ci && npm run admin:build && npx wrangler pages deploy admin/dist --project-name skbagheltravels-admin
